when.expression: #[(['PICKED_UP', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERED', 'EXCEPTION', 'DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED'] contains vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus) and (vars.isDuplicate == false) and (vars.isOutOfOrder == false) and (vars.isPendingUnknown == false)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var milestoneTemplates = { "PICKED_UP": "Good news! Your shipment has been picked up by the courier partner and is on its way.", "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY": "Out for delivery! Your package is with our delivery agent and will arrive today.", "DELIVERED": "Delivered successfully! Your shipment has been delivered at destination.", "EXCEPTION": "Delivery notice: An operational exception occurred. Our control tower team is resolving it promptly.", "DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED": "Delivery attempted: Courier agent attempted delivery. A re-attempt will be scheduled shortly." } --- { notificationId: "NOTIF-" ++ (uuid() as String)[0 to 7], shipmentId: vars.targetShipment.shipment_id default vars.canonicalEvent.shipmentId, trackingNumber: vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.canonicalEvent.carrier, milestone: vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus, eventTimestamp: vars.canonicalEvent.eventTimestamp, enqueuedTimestamp: (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: vars.correlationId, notificationType: "CUSTOMER_MILESTONE_ALERT", channels: ["EMAIL"], recipientEmail: vars.targetShipment.customer_email default (p('notification.email.defaultRecipient') default "customer@control-tower-logistics.com"), messageBody: milestoneTemplates[vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus] default "Status update received for your package.", location: vars.canonicalEvent.location }

logger.doc:name: Log Notification Enqueue
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Notification Queue] Enqueueing email alert for Tracking: ' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber default '') ++ ' | Milestone: ' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus default '') ++ ' | Queue: ' ++ (p('queue.milestoneQueue') default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log Queue Error
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Queue Warning] Milestone queue publish failed: ' ++ (error.description default 'Queue unavailable') ++ '. Notification record preserved in outbox.']

set-variable.value: #['Milestone queue publish failed for ' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber default '') ++ '. Preserved in outbox for retry.']
set-variable.doc:name: Set alertMessage

logger.doc:name: Log Suppressed Non-Milestone Event
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' ++ '[CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION SUPPRESSED (BY DESIGN)] ' ++ 'Reason: Status "' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus default '') ++ '" is an internal transit hop, or event is a duplicate. ' ++ 'Only major milestones (PICKED_UP, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, EXCEPTION, ATTEMPTED) trigger customer emails. ' ++ '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- (p('notification.email.subjectPrefix') default "[Control Tower Alert]") ++ " " ++ (vars.notificationItem.milestone default "UPDATE") ++ " - " ++ (vars.notificationItem.trackingNumber default "")

%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "" ++ "
" ++ "

Shipment Signal Control Tower

Real-Time Customer Milestone Alert

" ++ "

Dear Customer,

" ++ "

" ++ (vars.notificationItem.messageBody default "") ++ "

" ++ "
" ++ (vars.notificationItem.milestone default "") ++ "
" ++ " " ++ " " ++ " " ++ " " ++ " " ++ " " ++ "
Tracking Number:" ++ (vars.notificationItem.trackingNumber default "") ++ "
Carrier:" ++ (vars.notificationItem.carrier default "") ++ "
Current Location:" ++ (vars.notificationItem.location default "In Transit Hub") ++ "
Timestamp:" ++ (vars.notificationItem.eventTimestamp default "") ++ "
Notification ID:" ++ (vars.notificationItem.notificationId default "") ++ "

logger.doc:name: Log Real Email Sent
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Live Email Dispatch SUCCESS] Sent milestone email to ' ++ (vars.emailRecipient default '') ++ ' for tracking: ' ++ (vars.notificationItem.trackingNumber default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log SMTP Error
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Live Email Warning] Could not connect to external SMTP server: ' ++ (error.description default 'Network/Auth Error') ++ '. Event recorded in notification outbox.']

logger.message:
